title: WildLive X Development Live manifest
description: Two schema versions are supported. v1 is legacy bilingual (Japanese + English) and is retained for historical compatibility with manifests already merged to main. v2 is English-only and is the preferred format for all new manifests. The publisher (scripts/social/post_x.py) is authoritative — this schema mirrors its validation rules but is not what the workflow reads.

task.description: Human-readable label for the post header, e.g. 'Task 003'.

slug.description: Kebab-case ASCII slug matching the filename and the bilingual report slug.

post_on_merge.description: When false, the manifest is reviewed but not posted (documented no-op).

en.description: English post body. Must NOT include the PR URL or the #shipaton hashtag — the publisher appends both.

schema_version.description: Legacy bilingual manifest. Retained for compatibility with historically-merged manifests.

ja.description: Japanese post body. Must NOT include the PR URL or the #shipaton hashtag — the publisher appends both.

schema_version.description: English-only manifest — the preferred format for new posts. Rendering skips the JP body entirely.
